paragraphs: Thank you for participating in this survey, which takes about 4 minutes to complete and is restricted to participants using desktop devices only. Careless answers will misguide our research, so please read all the directions and questions carefully before you provide your answers.

This survey comes from Movora, which is an upcoming streaming platform featuring short dramas. Before launch, we would like to invite you to explore our platform and share your feedback, which can help us to better understand viewers’ preferences.

To ensure the best experience, please complete the survey in full-screen mode. After completing the survey, you can press the ESC key to exit full-screen mode. However, please do not exit early, as doing so may significantly affect your survey experience.
If you are ready, enter your Connect ID below and click Next to enter full-screen mode.

surveyIntroduction: In the next section, we would like to hear about your thoughts and feelings during the experience. Please answer the following questions based on your true thoughts.
affectInstructions: Now, we’d like to learn about your desired subjective state when selecting those short dramas. Please select one square in the grid below to indicate how you would like to feel compared with how you feel right now.
- Up or down: Select a square higher up if you need more arousal—that is, to feel more alert and stimulated—or lower down if you need less arousal.
- Left or right: Select a square farther to the right if you need to feel more pleasant, or farther to the left if you need to feel less pleasant.

The center square, marked N, represents your current state. Select this square if you do not need a change in either direction. Squares farther from the center indicate a greater desired change. Please consider both directions when choosing your square.

weeklyWorkHours.text: How many hours per week do you usually work for pay?
weeklyWorkHours.note: (Include hours from all paid jobs, including part-time work and self-employment. If you do not currently work for pay, please enter 0).

advertisementInstructions.text: As a potential Movora viewer, your perspective will help us understand which short dramas consumers want to watch. Thus, we want to invite you to explore Movora and share your feedback.
advertisementInstructions.afterAd: Next, you will be redirected to Movora and will see pairs of short dramas from different genres. For each pair, please choose the short drama you’d be more interested in watching.
notes: Note 1. There are no right or wrong answers. Please make each choice based on your first impression and personal preference.
Note 2. You’ll see two short dramas at a time. You can change your selection by clicking the other option any time before moving on to the next pair.
Note 3. Some follow-up questions will ask what you think about the specific short dramas you selected.
advertisementInstructions.entryPrompt: If you’ve read the instructions and agree to take part, click Watch on Movora on the ad to enter the platform.
